notes: Inventory stock snapshot -> MARD (plant/storage-location stock). Verified clean first: no duplicate (Item_ID, Warehouse_ID) pairs across all 252 rows, so the MARD key (MATNR/WERKS/LGORT) is unique. HOW THIS FITS WITH MOVEMENTS: in SAP, MARD-LABST is not loaded data -- it is the running sum of material movements. Carrying the snapshot as an initial stock level is the standard migration approach (initial inventory entry, movement type 561 in a real load): this spec loads the stock LEVEL, and the movement HISTORY is a separate, deliberately-deferred question -- see DATA_QUALITY_FINDINGS.md for why Stock Movements, Inventory Transfers, and Inventory Adjustments are not yet mapped (Receipt rows duplicate the goods-receipt data one-for-one, transfers need two-leg movements, and the adjustment arithmetic does not reconcile).
